AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jul-17-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a two Minors.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Helen Sorep-Matley.
Petitioner: Jian Fang Huang, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Jason So, and with Cantonese Interpreter.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
Mr. Wai Kwong Wong, the Minor's Father is also present in court, and consenting to the name change of the minor in open court.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Jason Wong.
Decree signed in open court.

AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME

Off Calendar Jun-12-2007 Reset To Jul-17-07 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Brenda Fields.
Petitioner: Jian Fang Huang, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Jason So, and with Cantonese Interpreter: Dan Lu.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
Improper information filed in the Petition and lacks the Minor's Father consent or proof of service on notice, the OSC for Change of Name of a Minor is continued to July 17, 2007 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
Petitioner to file an Amended Petition with correct information, and to submit proof of service for the OSC. Notice to the Minor's father of the new hearing date.
No objections to the proposed change of name of the minor were made at the hearing.
The Court waived Re-Publication requirement.
